css.description: All CSS loaded via wp_head() - no critical above-the-fold styles inlined
css.recommendation: Extract and inline critical CSS for hero section, header, and top bar (approx 200 lines)

css.description: Multiple deep selectors like '.modal-form .form-row' and '.footer-main .footer-links' reduce performance
css.recommendation: Flatten selectors using BEM methodology or utility classes
css.impact: Slower CSS parsing on mobile devices

css.description: 1561 lines of uncompressed CSS - no indication of minification process
css.recommendation: Implement CSS minification in build process (expected savings: ~40%)

css.description: Attorney profile styles defined but no usage found in templates
css.recommendation: Remove unused .attorney class or document where it's used

css.description: Font families repeated throughout instead of using CSS custom properties consistently
css.impact: Larger file size and maintenance issues

javascript.description: JavaScript loaded via wp_head() without defer/async attributes - blocks HTML parsing
javascript.recommendation: Move scripts to footer with 'in_footer' => true in wp_enqueue_script

javascript.description: DOM elements queried multiple times instead of caching
javascript.recommendation: Elements already cached at top - ensure consistent usage
javascript.impact: Minor performance hit on page load

javascript.description: IntersectionObserver not disconnected - continues to observe after animation complete
javascript.recommendation: Call observer.disconnect() after all elements animated or observer.unobserve(entry.target) per element
javascript.impact: Memory leak - ~1-2KB per observer over time

javascript.description: Multiple scroll event listeners fire on every scroll event
javascript.recommendation: Implement requestAnimationFrame or throttle to max 60fps

javascript.description: Debounce timeout of 250ms is slightly high
javascript.recommendation: Reduce to 150ms for better responsiveness or use matchMedia listeners

assets.description: Logo images lack explicit dimensions causing layout shift
assets.recommendation: Add width='auto' height='60' to header logo, width='auto' height='50' to footer logo

assets.description: No loading='lazy' attribute on any images
assets.recommendation: Add loading='lazy' to footer logo and any below-fold images
assets.impact: Loads unnecessary images, slower initial page load

assets.description: No font-display: swap specified for web fonts (Merriweather, Open Sans)
assets.recommendation: Add @font-face rules with font-display: swap or use WebFont Loader
assets.impact: FOIT (Flash of Invisible Text) - text hidden for 3s while fonts load

assets.description: Font Awesome icons loaded but no preconnect for CDN
assets.recommendation: Add <link rel='preconnect' href='https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com'> or self-host icons

assets.description: No indication of image optimization or WebP format
assets.recommendation: Use WebP format with fallback, implement responsive images with srcset
assets.impact: Larger file size, slower LCP (Largest Contentful Paint)

semantic_html.description: Skip link targets #main-content but may not be visible to keyboard users
semantic_html.recommendation: Ensure skip link is visible on focus with proper CSS styling
semantic_html.impact: Keyboard users must tab through entire header

semantic_html.description: Font Awesome icons used without sr-only text labels
semantic_html.recommendation: Add Phone after icons or use aria-label on parent
semantic_html.impact: Screen reader users don't know what icons represent

semantic_html.description: Footer uses h4 headings but page may not have proper h2/h3 context
semantic_html.recommendation: Ensure page content uses proper h1 > h2 > h3 hierarchy before footer h4s
semantic_html.impact: Screen readers announce incorrect document structure

semantic_html.description: Nav element exists but lacks proper aria-label to distinguish from footer nav
semantic_html.recommendation: Add aria-label='Main navigation' to primary nav
semantic_html.impact: Multiple nav landmarks are indistinguishable to screen readers

keyboard.description: Close button is 40x40px - meets minimum but borderline
keyboard.recommendation: Consider increasing to 44x44px for better touch/keyboard targeting
keyboard.impact: Harder for motor-impaired users to activate

keyboard.issue: Focus styles rely on browser defaults
keyboard.description: No explicit :focus or :focus-visible styles defined for interactive elements
keyboard.recommendation: Add clear focus indicators with outline or box-shadow for all interactive elements
keyboard.impact: Keyboard users may lose track of focus position

keyboard.issue: Mobile menu button focus state unclear
keyboard.description: Hamburger button lacks visible focus indicator
keyboard.impact: Keyboard users can't see when menu button is focused

aria.description: Modal has role='dialog' and aria-hidden but missing aria-modal='true' and focus trap
aria.recommendation: Add aria-modal='true' to modal, implement focus trap to prevent tabbing outside
aria.impact: Screen reader users can navigate outside modal while it's open

aria.description: Button has aria-label but doesn't announce expanded/collapsed state
aria.recommendation: Add aria-expanded='false' attribute and toggle in JavaScript
aria.impact: Screen reader users don't know if menu is open or closed

aria.description: Error messages displayed visually but not associated with fields via ARIA
aria.recommendation: Add aria-describedby linking field to error message, use aria-live for dynamic errors
aria.impact: Screen reader users don't receive error feedback

aria.description: Submit button shows spinner but no aria-live announcement
aria.impact: Screen reader users don't know form is submitting

color_contrast.impact: Text hard to read for low-vision users

color_contrast.recommendation: Use #fcd34d (lighter gold) for 4.5:1 ratio or increase font weight
color_contrast.impact: Critical message not readable by all users
Footer links slightly hard to read

color_contrast.description: Button disabled in JS but no visual indicator beyond cursor
color_contrast.recommendation: Add CSS for button[disabled] with reduced opacity and different background
color_contrast.impact: Sighted users may not realize button is disabled

forms.issue: Required fields only indicated by asterisk
forms.description: Placeholder text includes * but no aria-required or aria-label
forms.impact: Screen reader users don't know which fields are required

forms.description: Using placeholder instead of <label> elements with for/id association
forms.recommendation: Add proper <label> elements even if visually hidden
forms.impact: Screen readers can't properly announce field purpose

forms.description: Error messages injected via JavaScript without ARIA live region
forms.recommendation: Add permanent aria-live='polite' container for form errors
forms.impact: Screen readers miss dynamically added error messages

forms.description: Label wraps checkbox but input lacks id/for association as backup
forms.recommendation: Add id to input and for to label for better compatibility
forms.impact: Assistive tech may not associate label with checkbox

forms.description: Select dropdown uses placeholder option instead of label
forms.recommendation: Add <label> with for='legalIssue' even if visually hidden
forms.impact: Screen readers don't announce field purpose clearly

critical_fixes.fix: Move JavaScript to footer and add defer attribute
critical_fixes.code:
wp_enqueue_script('mydefenselaw-main', get_template_directory_uri() . '/assets/js/main.js', array(), '1.0.0', true);
wp_script_add_data('mydefenselaw-main', 'defer', true);

critical_fixes.fix: Add aria-modal and focus trap to modal
critical_fixes.code: Add aria-modal='true' to modal div. Implement focus trap in openModal() function using focusable element list and keydown listener for Tab key.
Add width='auto' height='60' to header logo (line 58, 60), width='auto' height='50' to footer logo (line 29, 31)

critical_fixes.fix: Add aria-required to required form fields
critical_fixes.code: Add aria-required='true' to all inputs with required attribute
Add <label> elements with for/id associations for all form inputs, style with sr-only class if needed

critical_fixes.fix: Add font-display: swap to web fonts
critical_fixes.code: @font-face { font-family: 'Open Sans'; font-display: swap; /* other rules */ }

critical_fixes.fix: Add aria-expanded to mobile menu button
critical_fixes.code: Add aria-expanded='false' to mobile menu button, toggle value in JavaScript when menu opens/closes
Extract CSS for header, top-bar, navigation (approx lines 1-243 from main.css) and inline in <head> before wp_head()
Change .cta-label color to #475569, .emergency-notice color to #fcd34d, footer links opacity to 0.9
Add loading='lazy' attribute to footer logo and other below-fold images

recommendations.description: Add preconnect for external resources and DNS prefetch for third-party domains
recommendations.implementation: Add to header.php before wp_head(): <link rel='preconnect' href='https://fonts.googleapis.com'> <link rel='dns-prefetch' href='https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com'>

recommendations.description: Throttle scroll events, disconnect observers after animations, debounce resize handlers
recommendations.implementation: Refactor scroll listeners to use requestAnimationFrame, add observer.disconnect() in animation callback

recommendations.recommendation: Add skip links for all major sections
recommendations.description: Include skip links to navigation, main content, and footer
recommendations.implementation: Add skip links after body tag with proper CSS for keyboard-only visibility

recommendations.description: Add visible focus indicators to all interactive elements, manage focus in modal
recommendations.implementation: Add :focus-visible styles throughout CSS, implement focus trap in modal with first/last element tracking

recommendations.description: Split JavaScript into critical and non-critical bundles
recommendations.implementation: Separate modal/form handling from main navigation, load form validation only when needed

recommendations.description: Implement live regions for dynamic content updates
recommendations.implementation: Add aria-live='polite' containers for form submission status, loading states, and error messages

recommendations.description: Use CSS containment, reduce specificity, remove unused styles
recommendations.implementation: Add contain: layout style; to independent components, run PurgeCSS to remove unused rules

recommendations.description: Add fieldsets, legends, and proper error associations
recommendations.implementation: Group related fields in fieldsets, use legend for group labels, add aria-describedby for errors

recommendations.description: Add PWA capabilities with offline support and asset caching
recommendations.implementation: Create service worker to cache static assets, enable offline navigation
Create dark theme color palette, add media query styles, respect user system preferences
